harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «تنزيل»: mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «لا ريب فيه» is parenthetical, and the preposition «من رب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, for digression (iḍrāb). The clause «يقولون» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «هو الحق». The preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «الحق». The interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to an implied verb, i.e. "He sent it down so that you may warn". The clause «ما أتاهم» is a naʿt of «قوما»; «نذير» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من قبلك» is attached to a naʿt of «نذير». The clause «لعلهم يهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective). «بينهما»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause). The preposition «في ستة» is attached to «خلق». The clause «ما لكم من دونه من ولي» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «الله»; «وليّ» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar, and the preposition «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ولي».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «يدبر» is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) {اللَّهُ}. The clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم». The preposition «ممَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «سنة».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «الذي»: fourth khabar (predicate). The clause «خلقه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كل». The preposition «من طين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بدأ».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition «من سلالة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and the preposition «من ماء» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «سلالة».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل». «قليلا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive. «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis, "we will be raised". The clause «أئنا لفي خلق جديد» is explicative of the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "we will be raised". The clause «بل هم كافرون» is resumptive, and the preposition «بلقاء» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ترجعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يتوفَّاكم».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ولو ترى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قُلْ}, and the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو» is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a dreadful thing". The clause «المجرمون ناكسو» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترى»; the past adverb was used here because the seeing is certain to occur. The vocative clause with its response is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied "saying", and this saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying: our Lord". The clause «إنَّا موقنون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «ولو شئنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَوْ تَرَى}. The clause «ولكن حق القول» is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "but I did not will that, so it became due". The clause «لأملأنَّ» is the answer to the oath, and the oath with its response is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). «أجمعين»: tawkīd (emphasis) of الناس, genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «فذوقوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the object of «ذوقوا» is omitted, i.e. "the punishment". The bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذوقوا». «هذا»: a demonstrative, naʿt (adjective) of «يومكم», interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "the one pointed to". The clause «إنا نسيناكم» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «إنما»: the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect. «الذين»: fāʿil (agent), and the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause). «سُجَّدًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «خَرُّوا». The preposition «بحمد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the wāw. The clause «وهم لا يستكبرون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «سبَّحوا».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «تتجافى جنوبهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «سبَّحوا», and the clause «يَدْعُون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «جنوبهم». «خوفا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The clause «ينفقون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدعون».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «فلا تعلم» is resumptive. The preposition «من قرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». «جزاء»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition «بما» is attached to the maṣdar (جزاء).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The fāʾ is resumptive. «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «كَمَنْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its implied khabar (predicate). The clause «لا يستوون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «فلهم جنات» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). «نزلا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جنات». The bāʾ is a preposition of causation, «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «فمأواهم النار» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «كلَّ»: an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعيدوا». «ما» is maṣdariyya and temporal, the maṣdar «أن يخرجوا» is the object of أراد, and the interpreted maṣdar «ما أرادوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is "they will be returned into it at every time of their wanting". The clause «أعيدوا» is resumptive, and the clause «وقيل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أعيدوا». «الذي»: naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «لنذيقنهم» is the answer to the oath, and the oath with its response is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَقِيلَ}. «دون»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نذيق». The clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive; «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أظلم». The clause «إنا من المجرمين منتقمون» is resumptive, and the preposition «من المجرمين» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «فلا تكن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «آتينا», and «الكتاب» is the second object. The preposition «مِنْ لقائه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مرية», and the preposition «لبني» is attached to a naʿt of «هدى».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «يهدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أئمة». The clause «لمَّا صبروا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوقنون».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «هو يفصل» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». The preposition «فيما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يَفْصِل», and the preposition «فيه» is attached to «يختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The wāw is resumptive. «يهد» means "become clear", and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun of the implied destroying. «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) one, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أهلكنا», and the preposition «من القرون» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «يمشون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from القرون. The clause «كم أهلكنا» explains the implied fāʿil. The clause «أفلا يسمعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ}. The interpreted maṣdar «أنَّا نسوق» is the object of «رأى». The clause «تأكل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «زرعا». The clause «أفلا يبصرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «ويقولون» is resumptive. «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هذا». «الفتح»: badal (substitute). The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفع». «إيمانهم»: fāʿil (agent) of «ينفع». The clause «ولا هم ينظرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لا ينفع».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «فأعرض» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنهم منتظرون».
